name: SampleLinearBlock
description: The simplest useful block: a single Linear layer + ReLU.

name: SampleMLPBlock
description: A richer example: a 2-layer MLP with a configurable hidden size and an optional residual connection.

name: AttentionPooling
description: Attention-weighted pooling with a single learnable query token.

name: CrossAttention
description: Attention from a query stream to a separate key/value stream.

name: LinearAttention
description: Linear-complexity attention via the kernel trick (Performer-lite).

name: MultiHeadAttention
description: Standard multi-head attention with optional causal masking.

name: RelativePositionBias
description: T5-style logarithmic relative-position bias.

name: RotaryEmbedding
description: Rotary positional embedding (Su et al. 2021 / LLaMA).

name: WindowAttention
description: Local attention restricted to fixed-size windows of length ``W``.

name: apply_rotary
description: Rotate the last dim of ``x`` by RoPE angles. ``x`` is ``(B,H,T,D)``.

name: scaled_dot_product_attention
description: ``softmax(QK^T / sqrt(d)) V`` - delegating to fused kernels when available.

name: ASPP
description: Atrous Spatial Pyramid Pooling - DeepLab v3.

name: CBAM
description: Convolutional Block Attention Module - channel + spatial attention.

name: DeformableAttention
description: Multi-head deformable attention (Zhu et al. - Deformable DETR).

name: DeformableConv2d
description: Deformable convolution v1 (Dai et al. 2017) implemented with grid_sample.

name: FeaturePyramidNetwork
description: Top-down FPN with lateral 1x1 connections (Lin et al. 2017).

name: InceptionBlock
description: Naive Inception-v1 module: 1x1, 3x3, 5x5 and pool branches.

name: PixelShuffleUpsample
description: Sub-pixel convolution: ESPCN / SRResNet upsampler.

name: SpatialPyramidPooling
description: Multi-scale pyramid average pooling, output is flattened.

name: SqueezeExcitation
description: Hu et al. 2017 - SE channel attention.

name: AdaIN
description: Adaptive Instance Normalization (Huang & Belongie 2017).

name: ConvBlock
description: Conv2D -> Norm -> Activation. The most common conv "lego" piece.

name: DepthwiseSeparableConv2d
description: Depthwise 3x3 followed by pointwise 1x1 (MobileNet-style).

name: Mish
description: Mish activation: ``x * tanh(softplus(x))``.

name: RMSNorm
description: Root-Mean-Square LayerNorm (LLaMA / T5-v1.1).

name: ResidualBlock
description: ResNet "basic block": ``y = act(F(x) + shortcut(x))``.

name: SPADE
description: Spatially-Adaptive (De)normalization (Park et al. 2019).

name: SkipConnection
description: Generic residual / skip wrapper: ``y = combine(f(x), x)``.

name: ColumnParallelLinear
description: Linear whose ``out_features`` are sharded across the tensor-parallel group.

name: LowRankLinear
description: Replaces a dense ``in_features x out_features`` layer with two thin layers.

name: PipelineStage
description: A single stage of a pipeline: takes input from prev stage, sends to next.

name: QuantizedLinear4bit
description: Simulated 4-bit symmetric weight quantization stored two-per-byte.

name: QuantizedLinearInt8
description: Simulated INT8 linear: stores INT8 weights, dequantizes for matmul.

name: RowParallelLinear
description: Linear whose ``in_features`` are sharded; performs all-reduce after matmul.

name: TokenPruner
description: Drops the lowest-scoring tokens to a fixed keep ratio (DynamicViT-style).

name: quantize_int8
description: Per-output-row symmetric INT8 quantization, returning ``(qweight, scale)``.

name: CLIPLoss
description: CLIP loss with a learnable temperature ``logit_scale``.

name: LearnedPositionalEmbedding
description: Standard nn.Embedding-based positional encoding (BERT-style).

name: ProjectionHead
description: SimCLR-style 2-layer MLP projection head.

name: SinusoidalPositionalEmbedding
description: Vaswani et al. 2017 - non-learned sinusoidal positions.

name: info_nce
description: Symmetric InfoNCE / NT-Xent loss used by SimCLR & CLIP.

name: DiscriminatorBlock
description: Strided conv -> norm -> LeakyReLU.

name: EqualConv2d
description: Equalized-LR 2-D convolution (StyleGAN family).

name: EqualLinear
description: Equalized-LR linear used by Progressive GAN / StyleGAN.

name: GeneratorBlock
description: Up-sample -> conv -> norm -> activation.

name: MappingNetwork
description: StyleGAN ``z -> w`` mapping network (8-layer MLP).

name: MinibatchStdDev
description: Karras et al. 2017 - appends per-batch std as an extra feature map.

name: ModulatedConv2d
description: StyleGAN2 modulated/demodulated convolution.

name: ProgressiveGrowing
description: Smooth fade between low- and high-resolution outputs by parameter ``alpha``.

name: StyleBlock
description: Combines :class:`ModulatedConv2d` with noise injection and an activation.

name: AffineCouplingLayer
description: RealNVP affine coupling: half the dims are scaled/shifted by the other half.

name: AutoregressiveBlock
description: A residual gated PixelCNN block.

name: EnergyBasedModel
description: Wraps any net so its scalar output is the energy ``E_theta(x)``.

name: MaskedConv2d
description: Masked 2D conv used by PixelCNN.

name: VAE
description: Minimal convolutional VAE; designed for 64x64 inputs by default.

name: reparameterize
description: ``z = mu + sigma * eps``,  ``eps ~ N(0, I)``.

name: GraphAttention
description: Multi-head Graph Attention layer (Velickovic 2018).

name: GraphConv
description: Symmetric-normalized GCN layer: ``X' = D^{-1/2} A D^{-1/2} X W``.

name: MessagePassing
description: Generic message passing: ``out = aggregate(message(x_src, x_dst, e))``.

name: ExternalMemory
description: Soft addressable key/value memory (NTM/Memory-Networks flavour).

name: MemoryAttention
description: Cross-attention over an external memory bank (e.g. retrieved facts).

name: PerceiverResampler
description: Compresses a long sequence of input tokens into ``num_latents`` queries.

name: QFormer
description: Bridges a frozen image encoder and a frozen LLM via learnable query tokens.

name: CheckpointedSequential
description: Sequential that runs each submodule under :func:`torch.utils.checkpoint`.

name: clip_grad_norm
description: Thin alias for :func:`torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_`.

name: ActorCritic
description: Combined actor-critic network sharing a torso.

name: PolicyNetwork
description: Stochastic policy ``pi_theta(a|s)`` for either discrete or continuous actions.

name: QNetwork
description: Action-value ``Q(s, a)`` with a discrete output head.

name: ValueNetwork
description: State value ``V_phi(s)``.

name: GRUCell
description: Cho et al. 2014 - simplified gating.

name: LSTMCell
description: LSTM cell with explicit input / forget / cell / output gates.

name: MambaBlock
description: A small Mamba-style block: depthwise conv + selective scan + gate.

name: RNNCell
description: ``h_t = tanh(W_ih x_t + W_hh h_{t-1} + b)``.

name: StateSpaceModel
description: Diagonal SSM with learnable continuous parameters.

name: run_recurrent
description: Apply ``cell`` along the time dimension of ``x: (B, T, D)``.

name: selective_scan
description: Sequential selective scan: ``x_t = exp(d*A) x_{t-1} + d*B u_t``.

name: CapsuleLayer
description: Fully-connected capsule layer with dynamic routing.

name: FNOBlock
description: Spectral conv + pointwise residual + nonlinearity (Li et al. 2020).

name: KANLayer
description: A single layer of a Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (Liu et al. 2024).

name: NeuralODE
description: Continuous-depth network: integrate ``dh/dt = f_theta(h, t)`` with explicit Euler.

name: SlotAttention
description: Slot Attention (Locatello et al. 2020) for object-centric learning.

name: SpectralConv2d
description: The core spectral conv used inside FNO.

name: dynamic_routing
description: Standalone dynamic routing on pre-computed votes ``(B, O, I, D)``.

name: squash
description: Sabour et al. 2017 - non-linear "squash" that keeps direction but compresses norm.

name: FeedForward
description: Vanilla two-layer MLP used inside transformer blocks.

name: GEGLU
description: GEGLU FFN: variant of GLU with a GELU gate (Shazeer 2020).

name: MixtureOfExperts
description: Token-level top-k MoE FFN (Shazeer / Switch / Mixtral).

name: SwiGLU
description: SwiGLU FFN used in LLaMA / PaLM: ``Linear(SiLU(W1 x) * W3 x) -> W2``.

name: TransformerDecoderBlock
description: Pre-norm decoder block: causal self-attn + cross-attn + MLP.

name: TransformerEncoderBlock
description: Pre-norm encoder block (BERT/ViT style).

name: ControlNetBlock
description: Toy ControlNet hint encoder - encodes control image and adds via ZeroConv.

name: DownsampleBlock
description: Strided 3x3 conv (or avg-pool) for halving spatial size.

name: HyperNetwork
description: Small network that generates ``in_dim -> out_dim`` weight matrices on-the-fly.

name: IPAdapterCrossAttention
description: Two-stream cross-attention: text + image-prompt features (Ye et al. 2023).

name: LoRAConv2d
description: LoRA wrapper for a frozen :class:`nn.Conv2d`.

name: LoRALinear
description: Low-rank adapter for a frozen ``nn.Linear``: ``W' = W + (B A) * alpha/r``.

name: NoisePredictor
description: Wraps a UNet so it predicts noise ``epsilon_theta(x_t, t, c)``.

name: SinusoidalTimeEmbedding
description: Diffusion-style sinusoidal embedding of integer timesteps.

name: TimestepMLP
description: Sinusoidal embedding followed by a 2-layer MLP - used by DDPM/SD.

name: UNet
description: A compact diffusion-style UNet.

name: UNetResBlock
description: Diffusion-style residual block conditioned on a time embedding.

name: UpsampleBlock
description: Restores spatial resolution via interpolation, transposed conv, or pixel shuffle.

name: classifier_free_guidance
description: ``eps = eps_uncond + s * (eps_cond - eps_uncond)``.

name: CLSToken
description: Learnable [CLS] token prepended to each sequence.

name: PatchEmbedding
description: Image -> sequence of patch tokens via a strided conv.

name: ShiftedWindowAttention
description: Cyclic-shift variant enabling cross-window communication (Swin).

name: SwinWindowAttention
description: Standard non-shifted window attention used inside Swin blocks.
